data.notes: The review gets the header right, including the international-only split, and challenges 'decided before we got in the room' with the coverage facts. Its message, proof and words actions match the key, and it keeps Adyen's test results unknown. The decider insight misses the key finding that the decision was made before we engaged, and it repeats the message finding's point (his own numbers instead of averages); it also leaves out the 9–10 months without a business review.
